verdict.rationale: Pinecone documents its own Inference API, which generates vector embeddings with embedding models hosted on Pinecone's infrastructure, so you don't have to run your own embedding service. The evidence does not show the index itself embedding records automatically at upsert or query time, nor configuring external model providers. Docs-18's note that full-text search needs 'No model required' only implies that other modes use a model. missing for 10: documented integrated embedding at ingest and query inside the index, configurable third-party model providers, list of supported models, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can have the database generate embeddings at ingest and query time using built-in or configured model providers, instead of running a separate embedding pipeline

citations.quote: Use the Inference API to generate vector embeddings and rerank results using embedding models and reranking models hosted on Pinecone's infrastructure.
Full-text search is BM25 token matching with Lucene query syntax over text fields in your schema... No model required
